references.text: God's promise to Isaac that his descendants will inherit the land, the same promise Israel now reminds Joseph of.
God's promise to Jacob regarding the land and protection is repeated, mirroring the promise Israel gives to Joseph.
God's promise of the land to Abraham's descendants, which also includes Joseph and his offspring.
God assures Jacob that He will make his descendants into a great nation in Egypt but will also bring them back to their ancestors' land.
Joseph's faith in God's promise to lead the children of Israel back to Canaan.
Joseph's faith in God's promises is cited as an example of faith in Hebrews.
Joseph confirms and continues Jacob's prophecy about leaving Egypt for the promised land.
Joseph's request to have his bones taken along is the concrete action linked to the prophecy in 48:21 regarding the exodus.
Jacob's wish to be buried in Canaan (47:29) is a concrete expression of his faith in the promise of return given in 48:21.
God's promise to be with them and lead the people back to their ancestors' land is repeated from Jacob (31:3) until his deathbed words (48:21).
The new journey home of Joseph to Israel's land in Matt 2:20 is a typological fulfillment of the prophecy about leaving Egypt in 48:21.
